QF.id: AIFM CIII Governance and Due Diligence_31

question.text: Per Chapter 11.6, key management personnel (KMP) of an AIF Manager shall INCLUDE all of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Members of key investment team of the Manager, as disclosed in the PPM
Employees involved in decision-making — MD, CEO, CIO, Whole-Time Directors, or equivalent
Any other person declared as KMP by the AIF or Manager
The fund's external distribution partners acting purely as sellers

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Chapter 11.6, KMP of an AIF Manager is defined to include (a) members of the key investment team disclosed in the PPM, (b) employees involved in decision-making such as MD/CEO/CIO/Whole-Time Directors or equivalent, and (c) any other person declared as KMP by the AIF or Manager. The Trap: External distribution partners acting purely as sellers do not fall within the KMP definition unless they are separately declared as KMP by the AIF or Manager. Note: The KMP definition is scoped to decision-makers and persons specifically declared as KMP, not to general sales or distribution counterparties.
